desc: Derive the segment-tree invariant for all candidate second cuts \(j\) during a sweep over the first cut \(i\).
Determine the range updates caused by removing \(A_i\) from the middle segment as \(i\) advances, using next occurrence positions.
Precompute prefix and suffix distinct counts and initialize scores for every \(j\in[1,N-1]\).
Implement lazy range-add/range-maximum with invalid second-cut boundaries in \(O(N\log N)\).
Prove correctness and verify endpoint handling against brute-force reasoning and all public samples.
